name: ChangePosition
description: Use only during sex with the player, when the speaking NPC agrees to switch to a different position (because the player asked, or because she wants to). Only agree if it fits her mood and personality; she may say no instead.
note: Needs OStim and Mantella - Adult Expansion - OStim (flows built). Plays a matching animation from the installed packs.

position.description: The new position, exactly one of: standing face to face, standing from behind, carry, kneeling, sitting / lap, missionary, lying on back, spooning, sixtynine, prone, doggystyle, cowgirl, reversecowgirl, facesitting.

prompt: If you agree to switch to a different sex position, begin your response with '{key}:'
